rulesets.c6: Match the REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY: the SAME cleric — a white hood with gold trim over blonde hair, white and gold robes with a deep-green underlayer, holding a tall golden staff topped with a large green gem. Reproduce the reference's hand-drawn pixel-art style precisely: same dot size, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, same body proportions (stocky heroic chibi), same palette. THREE-QUARTER FRONT view at eye level, the FULL BODY standing, both feet visible on the ground. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. LAYOUT: a 3-column by 2-row grid of 6 cells with clear empty pure-magenta gaps between the cells. The SAME knight, SAME scale, SAME camera angle in every cell, feet resting on a common baseline. The six poses MUST differ dramatically so motion is obvious when flipped through. Follow each cell's description literally. No grid lines, no labels, no text. COLOR: full color, matching the reference palette. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no ground, no shadow, no scenery.
